opportunities.title: Three Complete VTuber Model Sets
opportunities.description: # Looking for an artist to make 3 VTuber characters in 2D and 3D I’m building GalaxyLume and looking for an artist or small team to make three original characters: - **Galaxy** — female character - **Lume** — male character - **Orbit** — robot character Each character needs a matching **2D Live2D model** and **full-body 3D VRM model**, for six finished, rigged models total. I’d like to approve the rough designs, colors, and outfits first. Please include front, side, and back references so the 2D and 3D versions stay consistent. These are for live chat on my website. The user’s webcam and mic will drive the avatar in their browser. Other people in the call will see only the avatar, with the background handled by GalaxyLume. Users should be able to pick a character without installing an app or manually downloading or importing a model. I also want to use the 3D versions in games and VR rooms later. ### 2D models - Deliver a **Live2D Cubism 4-compatible export** for each character with `.model3.json`, `.moc3`, texture atlases, and all referenced physics, expression, and motion files. Keep the folder paths intact. Include the **editable `.cmo3` project and layered PSD**. - Rig head turns, looking up and down, head tilt, eye gaze, independent blinks, mouth opening and shape, and upper-body sway. The avatar should be able to talk and blink while moving its head or using an expression. - Use the parameter IDs our player already reads: `ParamAngleX`, `ParamAngleY`, `ParamAngleZ`, `ParamEyeLOpen`, `ParamEyeROpen`, `ParamMouthOpenY`, and `ParamMouthForm`. Document any extra controls. - Frame the model for an upper-body chat view, with enough room for gestures. Keep the background transparent and hair or clothing physics lightweight. ### Expressions and chat gestures for both versions I want the characters to have a good range of reactions. For each character, include **neutral, happy, laughing, surprised, confused, sad, angry, and embarrassed**. Deliver these as individually selectable expressions and show how each looks while the character is talking. Orbit can use its display, lights, eyes, or moving parts to show the same emotions. Include a **relaxed idle, wave hello, nod yes, shake head no, and a short cheer** for each version. These should be separate motions GalaxyLume can trigger in chat, with a clean return to idle. Please show which expressions can be combined with blinking and lip sync. ### Full-body 3D models - Deliver a **self-contained `.vrm` with embedded textures**, a **rigged `.glb`** for games and VR, and the **editable Blender project** with its mesh, armature, weights, materials, source textures, and facial shapes. VRM 1.0 is preferred, subject to an early test in our player. - Use a standard humanoid rig with hips, spine, head, arms, hands, articulated fingers, legs, feet, and toes. Both soles should sit level in the neutral standing pose. Orbit should also use a humanoid bone mapping. Document the model height, forward direction, ground origin, and how we can hide the head in first-person VR. - Include eye movement, independent `blinkLeft` and `blinkRight`, `happy`, and the five standard VRM mouth shapes `aa`, `ih`, `ou`, `ee`, and `oh`. Document the names of any custom expressions so we can trigger the same reactions across all three characters. - In addition to the chat gestures, include **walk, run, crouch, and jump with landing**. Deliver editable clips and game-ready exports. Tell me which clips play in place and which move the character forward. - Send a short rig demo showing a **deep bow, side lean, straight forward leg lift, bent-knee lift, crouch, and landing**. Show the bow and leg lifts from the side with the feet visible. I want to see that the joints bend cleanly and that clothing, shoes, and Orbit’s mechanical parts hold up through those poses. ### File sizes and testing Package each character and format separately so the site can load only the one someone picks. **Give me your estimated file sizes for the web versions in your bid.** We’ll agree on a realistic size after seeing the early exports. Keep the editable source files, optional outfits, and extra animations separate from the files the base avatar needs to load. I want an **early working 2D export and 3D export of the same character** before you finish all six. We’ll test them in GalaxyLume for loading, smooth movement, expressions, lip sync, and how they look in chat. Please include one round of fixes for rigging or export problems we find in our player. Final delivery should include all six working models, editable projects, animations, preview images, and a short README with export versions, controls, file sizes, texture sizes, and 3D triangle and material counts. Please flag any required plugins or third-party assets in your bid. ### How to bid **Please give me a real price for the work you’re offering. No placeholder bids.** Break the price down by character and by 2D and 3D work, list your milestones, and give a realistic timeline. If you only do one format, that’s fine. Quote the exact part you can deliver and say what’s included. Please link to examples of your rigs **in motion**, including facial expressions and full-body movement where applicable. This job covers the characters, rigs, animations, and exports. If you also develop browser webcam tracking, quote that separately and show a working demo. **We’ll request Freelancer’s IP Agreement for the awarded project.**

opportunities.title: Build Donation-Enabled NGO Website
opportunities.description: I need a clean, responsive website where supporters can help my NGO directly online. The key feature is a secure donation flow that offers three options out of the box: a single one-time gift, an automated monthly pledge, and contributions tied to specific fundraising campaigns. Any modern stack is fine—WordPress with GiveWP, a custom PHP/Laravel solution, or a lightweight Jamstack build—as long as I can update text and images myself after launch. The design should feel trustworthy, load quickly on mobile, and sit under my own domain with an SSL certificate in place. Deliverables • Live, fully responsive site installed on my host and domain • Donation module configured for one-time, monthly, and campaign-based gifts, connected to a mainstream payment gateway (Stripe, PayPal, or equivalent) • Short hand-off guide showing how to add content, check transaction logs, and export donor data Acceptance Criteria – Each type of donation completes end-to-end in test mode and produces a confirmation email for the donor and an entry in the admin dashboard. – Pages render correctly on the latest Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and common mobile browsers.

opportunities.title: Modern Showroom Interior Design
opportunities.description: I’m setting up a brand-new space that will showcase a curated mix of furniture, décor, and lighting. Starting from an empty shell, I need the full showroom concept developed—zoning, circulation routes, focal points, and everything in between—so contractors can move straight into build-out. The atmosphere has to read modern and minimal: clean lines, calm color stories, and sightlines that keep the customer journey intuitive while letting every piece stand out. Key deliverables • Master floor plan detailing category zones and traffic flow • Scaled placement map for furniture, accessories, and lighting points • Mood boards and material palette supporting the aesthetic • 3D visualizations or renders (SketchUp, 3ds Max, Revit—your choice) • Way-finding and signage recommendations that tie into the layout Your submission should highlight past work on retail or showroom projects that demonstrate effective flow planning and a modern sensibility. Source files must be provided at hand-over so my contractors can execute without delays. I look forward to creating a space that feels effortless to navigate and impossible to forget.

opportunities.title: Podcast Episodes Edited for YouTube
opportunities.description: I release a recurring video-podcast and I’m looking for help turning each recorded conversation into a clean, upload-ready YouTube episode. Here’s exactly what I need on every show: • Editing – a straightforward trim to remove dead air at the start and end, then slot the supplied intro and outro onto the timeline. No deep audio cleanup or graphic overlays are required; just make sure the cut flows naturally and the final render looks and sounds consistent. • YouTube package – once the episode is rendered, prepare everything necessary for publishing: a compelling title, an SEO-minded description that draws on my episode notes, a polished thumbnail, and time-stamped chapter markers so viewers can jump to key moments. I will always provide the final video and audio tracks, the branded intro/outro files, still images if needed, and written episode notes. You simply assemble, export, and ready the upload. The finished deliverable should be an .mp4 (or similar high-quality format) plus the accompanying text/thumbnail assets, or, if we’ve arranged channel access, the episode already scheduled on YouTube. If you’re comfortable with basic video editing tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve and you know your way around YouTube Studio, this will be a smooth, repeatable gig. Let’s make publishing each episode a breeze.

opportunities.title: Build Employee Training Portal
opportunities.description: Job brief – Employee information and training portal We need an experienced full-stack developer to build and deploy a modern web portal where each of our about 80 employees has a personal page. Employees get project information, guides and short training tasks there, and confirm when they have completed them. Admins push content to groups and see who has completed what. We want a working first version within 1–4 days. Overview We are a Norwegian organisation with about 80 employees, rolling out a new internal IT system. We want employees to feel informed and confident, and we want to know who has completed the training. • Users: about 80 employees and 2–5 admins. Expect a few hundred tasks and documents in the first year. • Language: the user interface must be in Norwegian (Bokmål). We will supply or review the texts. All interface strings must sit in one translation file. • Look and feel: modern, clean and friendly, on desktop and mobile. It should feel like a nice product, not an intranet. See the attached example screens. • Our identity: we will tell the selected freelancer who we are. Until then, please treat this as an anonymous client. • Example screens: we have made mock-ups of the employee page and the admin tool. Use them as a guide for layout and features, not as a pixel-perfect design. Employee features Each employee has a personal page at a stable address, for example /kari-nordmann, that shows only what is meant for them. 1. Personal start page: greeting with name, a progress bar ("7 of 10 tasks completed"), the next tasks due, and the latest news. 2. News and information: short posts from admins with text, images, links and attachments. Newest first, with unread posts marked. 3. Guides and documents: a library of user guides (PDF, Word, links to videos), searchable and grouped by topic. 4. Tasks: items the employee must complete, of three kinds: ◦ Read and confirm: "I have read this" checkbox. ◦ Process walk-through: a numbered list of steps (text and screenshots) where each step can be ticked off, ending with "I have completed the walk-through". ◦ Quiz: a few multiple-choice questions, with a pass mark set by the admin and a retry option. 5. Feedback: on every task, the employee can rate it (for example 1–5 or thumbs up and down) and write a comment or question. 6. Due dates and status: each task shows not started, in progress, completed or overdue. 7. Account: change password and log out. Admin features Admins must be able to run everything without a developer. Publishing to a group of employees must take a minute or two. 1. Employees: import from CSV (name, work email, department), add, edit and deactivate. Send invitation emails. 2. Groups: create groups (for example departments or project roles). An employee can belong to several groups. 3. Content: create and edit news posts, documents, read-and-confirm tasks, process walk-throughs and quizzes in a simple editor. Upload files and images. Save as draft or publish. 4. Targeting: send each item to everyone, to one or more groups, or to selected individuals. Optional due date. 5. Progress overview: a matrix of employees against tasks showing completed, in progress, not started and overdue. Filter by group or task, and export to CSV/Excel. 6. Reminders: send a reminder email to everyone who has not completed a task, with one click. 7. Feedback: see all ratings, comments and quiz results per task, with the employee's name. 8. Admin users: add or remove admins. Login and security The portal holds internal information, so a standard login is needed, but not high-security measures. • Login with work email and password. Only employees invited by an admin can log in, with no open sign-up. • First login: the invitation email contains a link to set your own password. • Forgotten password: reset by email link, valid for a limited time. • Change password from the account page. • Basics: passwords hashed (bcrypt or Argon2), HTTPS everywhere, rate limiting on login and reset, and an employee can only see their own page and progress. • Nice to have: "Sign in with Microsoft" (Microsoft Entra ID, single sign-on) as an alternative login. Please state in your bid whether you can do this and at what extra cost. • Privacy: data is stored in the EU/EEA. We will sign a data processing agreement with you before go-live. Technical requirements, hosting and domain We prefer a mainstream, well-documented stack that another developer can take over easily. • Stack: your choice, but it must be common and maintainable, for example Next.js with Supabase or PostgreSQL, Laravel or Django. Please no proprietary site builders and no stack that only you can maintain. • Hosting: managed hosting with an EU region (for example Vercel, Netlify, Render, Supabase EU or similar). Automatic HTTPS and daily database backups. • Email: a transactional email service (for example Postmark, Resend or SendGrid) for invitations, password resets and reminders. • Domain, phase 1: deploy on your own test domain or the hosting provider's default address, so we can test. • Domain, phase 2: we will then connect our own subdomain (for example portal.ourdomain.com) with a CNAME record that we create. Set up the custom domain and TLS certificate on the hosting side, and guide us through the DNS record. Personal pages run as paths on that subdomain (portal.ourdomain.com/kari-nordmann), not as one subdomain per employee. • Ownership: all code is in a Git repository transferred to us. Hosting, database and email accounts are created in our name, or transferred to us at handover. We own all code and content. Deliverables, milestones and acceptance We pay a fixed price in milestones, each released when we have tested and accepted it. Acceptance: an admin can import 80 employees, create a group, publish a walk-through and a quiz to that group, and see in the matrix who has completed them. Employees can log in, reset their password, complete tasks and give feedback on a phone and a PC. No errors in the browser console during these flows. After delivery: free bug fixes for 30 days. Please quote an hourly rate for later changes. How to apply Please include the following in your bid. Bids without these points will not be considered. 1. Links to 2–3 similar projects you built (portals, LMS, dashboards with login), preferably live. 2. Your proposed stack and hosting, and why. 3. A fixed price per milestone, and your realistic timeline in days. 4. Whether you can deliver "Sign in with Microsoft", and the extra cost. 5. Your availability: when you can start, and your time zone. 6. Any questions or assumptions about the scope. The selected freelancer must sign a confidentiality agreement (NDA) before the start, and a data processing agreement before real employee data is loaded.

opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional o equipo para implementar un agente de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) que se encargue de la atención y gestión de leads. Este agente deberá integrarse con un sistema CRM y con las plataformas de comunicación WhatsApp e Instagram. El objetivo principal es automatizar la interacción inicial con los leads, calificarlos y dirigirlos adecuadamente dentro del CRM. Actualmente, la empresa recibe aproximadamente 300 leads diarios, por lo que la solución debe ser escalable y eficiente. Es fundamental que la implementación del crm y la ia se realice con el menor costo posible, optimizando los recursos sin comprometer la calidad y funcionalidad. Este proyecto es la primera fase de una estrategia más amplia, ya que posteriormente se evaluarán nuevas mejoras con IA para optimizar otros procesos internos de la empresa. Se valorará la experiencia en integraciones complejas y soluciones de IA conversacional. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Inteligencia Artificial Tamaño del proyecto: Pequeño

opportunities.title: Service Showcase Business Website
opportunities.description: I’m launching my freelance practice and need a clean, responsive business website that introduces my services and provides visitors with an easy way to get in touch. The core goal is to present what I do clearly—no e-commerce or booking system—just a professional online presence with my service descriptions, portfolio snippets, and contact details. Here’s what will make the project a success: • Modern, mobile-friendly design that looks sharp on desktop, tablet, and phone • Home, About, Services, and Contact pages with space for future additions • Contact form that sends messages directly to my email, plus clickable phone/WhatsApp links • Built on a platform I can update myself later—WordPress, Webflow, or a lightweight custom CMS are all fine with me • Deployed to my domain and hosting, with full hand-over of source files and credentials • Basic on-page SEO (titles, meta, alt tags) and fast load times; passing Google’s Mobile-Friendly test and hitting 90+ on PageSpeed would be ideal Once live, I’ll need a short walkthrough (video or doc) showing how to edit text and images so I can keep the site fresh.

opportunities.title: Comprehensive Digital Automation & Design
opportunities.description: I have several projects moving at once and want a single, versatile partner who can keep everything flowing smoothly. The work spans three areas—AI automation and digital tools, design work for ads and thumbnails, plus website building and video editing—and I’d like to tackle all of them together rather than piecemeal. First priority is solid AI automation to take repetitive business tasks off my plate. Think report generation, spreadsheet and CRM updates, or any data-entry routine that can be handled through Zapier, Make, Python scripts, or similar tools. These workflows should also push out status updates or simple replies through my social-media and messaging channels so customers and team members stay in the loop without manual effort. Alongside the back-end automation, there’s a steady stream of creative jobs: producing ad creatives, eye-catching thumbnails, and short edits; refreshing or building pages on WordPress or Shopify; and polishing videos for web delivery. Adobe CC, Canva, Figma, Premiere Pro—use whatever you’re comfortable with as long as the result looks clean and professional. Weekly deliverables • Working automation workflows or scripts with brief, readable documentation • Finished graphic assets in editable formats (PSD, AI, or layered PNG) • Live site updates or new pages pushed to production with backups • Edited videos exported in 1080p H.264 Acceptance criteria • Automations run unattended for seven consecutive days without errors • Creative work follows my brand guidelines and size specs • Web pages load in under three seconds on mobile per PageSpeed Insights • Videos play smoothly and stay under the agreed file size limit I’ll supply access credentials, raw content, and brand materials. You keep me updated as milestones are reached and deliver polished, ready-to-use assets each week.

opportunities.title: Mid-Level Structural AutoCAD Drafter
opportunities.description: Job Description: Drafter Level II Department: Drafting Position Level: Mid-Level Reports To: Drafting Supervisor / Department Manager Position Summary: This is a Mid-level position focused on learning A & A Engineering's drafting standards, procedures, and software, and then being responsible for preparing accurate, high-quality drawings and for supporting clients and project teams with written correspondence and form preparation at A & A Engineering. This position works independently on a wide range of drafting assignments, communicates with clients as needed, Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Prepare Structural Drawings, revisions, and corrections under supervision. • Ensure drawings meet company standards for accuracy, completeness, and quality. • Apply and maintain company drafting standards, procedures, and drawing requirements, and help improve them as needed. • Complete and submit client and project forms, and similar paperwork, verifying that all information is correct and complete before submission. • Manage multiple tasks and deadlines at once, and communicate progress, questions, and potential delays to supervisors promptly. • Collaborate with Project Managers, engineers, and senior drafters to understand project requirements. • Communicate with clients, as needed, to gather information, clarify requirements, and follow up on open items. • Rarely but occasionally, write basic client-facing letters, transmittals, and project correspondence that are clear, professional, and accurate. Qualifications and Skills • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, including accuracy in completing forms and paperwork. • Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple assignments, and meet deadlines. • Professional verbal communication skills for working with clients, Project Managers, and engineers. • Fluency in written and spoken English. • Willingness to accept feedback, share knowledge, and continue developing new skills. • Familiarity with AutoCAD or similar drafting software required Performance Expectations • Demonstrate understanding of company drafting standards and procedures. • Complete simple drafting projects with increasing accuracy and independence. • Develop proficiency in drafting software and tools. • Improve productivity while maintaining drawing quality. • Demonstrate accountability, communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement. • Accept feedback and apply corrections to continuously improve skills. Overall Goal: Serve as a dependable, independent contributor who produces high-quality drawings, correspondence, and client support, and who can progress toward senior drafting or project coordination responsibilities. Software Skills: AutoCAD: strong proficiency required. Revit: not required but a plus if familiar. MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook): moderate proficiency required; Word proficiency is especially important for letters and correspondence. PDF editing software (Adobe, Foxit, Revu, etc.): moderate proficiency required.

opportunities.description: TITLE: Sales Outreach Freelancer: Find 10 Qualified Small Business Leads Weekly (Web Design Services) DESCRIPTION: I run a web design service and need a sales-focused freelancer to find and contact small businesses in India that have no website or a very weak online presence, and connect them with me. TARGET BUSINESSES: Dental clinics, salons, gyms, coaching centres, restaurants, local shops, repair services, boutiques, and other small local businesses. WHAT YOU WILL DO: - Find small businesses with no website or an outdated one (Google Maps, Justdial, Instagram, Facebook, local directories) - Contact the owner by phone, WhatsApp, email, or social media - Explain the benefit of a website and confirm they are genuinely interested - Share a short lead sheet with: business name, owner name, phone/WhatsApp, city, what they need, budget range, and notes from your conversation - Arrange a call between me and the interested owner WEEKLY TARGET: 10 qualified leads per week. A qualified lead means the owner has spoken with you, is interested, has a rough budget, and agrees to talk to me. WEBSITE PROJECT VALUE: Typically Rs [X] to Rs 40,000 depending on requirements. PAYMENT STRUCTURE: - Fixed payment of Rs [amount] for every qualified lead delivered - Plus 10% commission on the final project value for every lead that converts into a paid website project - Commission is paid within 7 days of my receiving payment from the client - Weekly payouts, tracked in a shared lead sheet REQUIREMENTS: - Proven experience in sales, telemarketing, lead generation, or business development - Fluent in English and Hindi (regional language is a plus) - Comfortable with cold calling and WhatsApp outreach - Honest reporting: no fake or unverified leads - Work remotely from any city in India - Please share past sales or lead generation experience DELIVERABLE: A weekly lead sheet (Google Sheet) with 10 qualified leads and call notes. opportunities.title: Plataforma IA para Protección Reputacional
opportunities.description: # Desarrollo de BOT y sistema automatizado contra campañas de difamación y ataques reputacionales ### Descripción del proyecto Buscamos un experto en desarrollo de bots, inteligencia artificial, automatización y ciberseguridad para desarrollar una herramienta tecnológica enfocada en la protección de la reputación digital de personas, marcas y empresas. opportunities.title: Modern G+2 House Layout Design
opportunities.description: I own a 15 m × 15 m plot in Sharjah and want a fresh, modern layout for a G + 2 single-family residence. Local rules demand a 3 m setback on every side, so the buildable footprint is 9 m × 9 m per floor; I’d like you to make the most of that space while staying fully compliant with Sharjah municipality guidelines and cultural preferences. The brief • Use the three floors to create a true single large family home. • Provide five bedrooms in total, each with a private bathroom if possible. • Give particular prominence to generous, connected family living and dining areas on the ground floor. • Fit in all essential service spaces (kitchen, laundry, maid’s room, storage and a lift core if feasible) without feeling cramped. • Allow for natural light, cross-ventilation and a logical vertical circulation path that works for all ages. Deliverables I expect • Dimensioned floor plans for ground, first and second floors (PDF + editable CAD). • Simple furniture layout in the plans to demonstrate real-life flow. • Area schedule showing built-up versus setback zones. • A quick 3D massing or SketchUp/Revit model to communicate volume and façade concept (no full renders needed at this stage). Acceptance criteria Plans must respect the 3 m clearances, include all stated spaces, list room areas, and align with Sharjah approval norms. Files should be delivered in DWG (AutoCAD) and PDF; any 3D massing in SKP or RVT is fine. If you’re familiar with UAE authority submissions, that’s a big plus. Share a sample of a similar G + 2 project you’ve designed, and let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Photorealistic Telescopic Mast VFX Animation
opportunities.description: **Photorealistic VFX Animation – Industrial Telescopic Mast** I need an experienced VFX/Blender artist to create an extremely realistic 8-minute engineering visualization using original video footage and an existing 3D IGES model. The project involves a two-stage telescopic steel mast with mechanical collars and chain transmission systems. **Animation sequence:** - 3 minutes: mast extending vertically to a total height of 20 meters. - 2 minutes: mast stationary at full extension. - 3 minutes: mast retracting to its original position. **Requirements:** - Fixed camera throughout the entire video. - Use the original real-world footage as the background. - Digitally extend the camera framing upwards to show the full 20-meter structure. - Animate the telescopic sections and chain mechanisms accurately. - Match real lighting, shadows, perspective and video texture. - Maximum photorealism, even at low resolution. - No generic AI-generated video. I will provide the original video, photographs and complete IGES mechanical model. The objective is a technically accurate, photorealistic simulation. The final video should be clearly identified as a CGI engineering visualization. Please include examples of similar VFX work and your fixed-price quotation. A short paid test will be required before awarding the complete project.

I will provide the original video, photographs and complete IGES mechanical model. The objective is a technically accurate, photorealistic simulation. The final video should be clearly identified as a CGI engineering visualization. Please include examples of similar VFX work and your fixed-price quotation. A short paid test will be required before awarding the complete project."

opportunities.title: Rifle Shooting Shoe 3D Animation
opportunities.description: I need a photorealistic 3D animation that presents my new rifle-shooting shoe with the same clean, dynamic feel as the Behance reference I linked. The storyline should revolve around the sole: show how its non-slip tread locks onto the ground, demonstrate the stable grip shooters rely on, and illustrate the way the midsole supports long periods of standing and micro-movement at the firing line. Please animate individual layers—outsole, midsole, upper—then reassemble them so viewers instantly grasp how each part contributes to flawless stability and performance. Text callouts or subtle motion graphics are welcome if they reinforce those points without cluttering the frame. Deliverables: • Finished video (1920×1080 or higher, H.264/MP4) ready for web and social use • Transparent-background passes or stills for marketing materials • Source project files so we can update colors or add language versions later Any mainstream 3D toolset works—Blender, Cinema 4D, Maya, Houdini—as long as the final look matches the polished style of the reference. Let me know your preferred software, estimated turnaround, and how many review rounds are included.

opportunities.title: Setter Telefónico para Barberías Españolas
opportunities.description: Setter telefónico con número español para llamar a 300 barberías (Castellón y Valencia) Busco un setter telefónico de Latinoamérica para llamar a unas 300 barberías de las provincias de Castellón y Valencia y detectar cuáles están interesadas en nuestros productos para barberías. Tu función es de setter: encontrar a las barberías interesadas y pasármelas. Yo me encargo de hablar con ellas y cerrar la venta. No tienes que vender ni dar precios. QUÉ HARÁS - Llamar a la lista de unas 300 barberías que te proporciono - Presentar la propuesta con un guion que te facilito - Detectar quién quiere más información y pasarme su contacto - Registrar el resultado de cada llamada en una hoja de cálculo compartida CLASIFICACIÓN DE CADA LLAMADA Cada barbería debe quedar en uno de estos estados: - Interesado: quiere más información, me lo pasas el mismo día - Se lo tiene que pensar: indicar cuándo volver a llamar - Ya trabaja con otra marca o proveedor: indicar cuál, si lo dice - No interesado - No contesta: después de 3 intentos en días y horas distintas - Número erróneo o negocio cerrado En cada registro: nombre de la barbería, ciudad, teléfono, estado, número de intentos, fecha de la última llamada, nombre de la persona con la que hablaste y notas. REQUISITOS OBLIGATORIOS - Número de teléfono español propio - Grabar todas las llamadas y darme acceso a las grabaciones - Experiencia en televenta, call center o captación - Disponibilidad para llamar de 10:00 a 19:00, hora de España - Buena conexión y audio claro INFORMES - Cada día: las barberías interesadas con sus datos - Cada semana: resumen con llamadas realizadas y número de barberías en cada estado CONTINUIDAD Al terminar con las barberías habrá que llamar a más empresas relacionadas con el sector, así que buscamos a alguien para una colaboración a largo plazo si el trabajo sale bien. PAGO Precio fijo por completar las 300 barberías, dividido en hitos por cada 100 barberías llamadas y registradas, más un bonus por cada barbería interesada que yo verifique. PARA APLICAR, INDICA: - País desde el que trabajas - Experiencia en llamadas comerciales - Qué sistema usas para tu número español y cómo me darías acceso a las grabaciones - Tu precio por las 300 barberías Antes de contratar haremos una llamada de prueba corta.

opportunities.title: Dialux Lux Simulation Support
opportunities.description: I need a Dialux specialist to run lighting calculations for several work-room layouts. I will hand over the AutoCAD floor plans along with the IES file for the chosen third-party luminaire. Your task is to model the rooms in Dialux, test different fixture quantities and placement options, and show which arrangement meets the target average lux while keeping uniformity within acceptable limits. Deliverables should include: • Dialux (or Dialux EVO) project files for each option • A brief PDF report with calculation grids, false-colour renderings and numerical summaries for average lux and uniformity • A short comparison table highlighting the pros and cons of each layout tested Please make sure the results are easy to follow so I can present them directly to the client and adjust the CAD drawings if needed.

opportunities.title: Bot WhatsApp para clínica odontológica
opportunities.description: Quiero implementar un sistema automatizado en WhatsApp que atienda a mis pacientes de forma fluida y profesional. El flujo principal debe: • Responder a mensajes entrantes y ofrecer tres opciones claras: «Citas para consultas y tratamientos», «Seguimiento de revisiones y recordatorios» y «Recuperación de pacientes que no han vuelto». • Preguntar únicamente el nombre, teléfono, fecha de nacimiento y servicio que necesita antes de intentar agendar. • Analizar el calendario y agendar la cita en la disponibilidad más próxima, en caso de superar la semana, enviar la solicitud de cita a un miembro del equipo que mantendrá el contacto con el cliente para que confirme el horario; una vez aprobada, devolver la confirmación al paciente junto con la ubicación y políticas básicas. • Registrar la cita en nuestro calendario (Google Calendar o similar) y programar recordatorios automáticos antes de la visita y en los controles posteriores. • Detectar pacientes que lleven tiempo inactivos, activar una campaña de re-enganche y ofrecer servicios relevantes según su historial. Registrar fecha de nacimiento para ofrecer al cliente una oferta especial por su cumpleaños. Busco una solución llave en mano: diseño del flujo conversacional, configuración del bot con la API oficial de WhatsApp o una plataforma como Twilio o Zenvia, integración con nuestro calendario y un pequeño panel donde pueda hacer ajustes básicos sin depender del desarrollador. Entrego acceso a mi número empresarial y al calendario; necesito documentación breve y una sesión de traspaso para el equipo.

El flujo principal debe: • Responder a mensajes entrantes y ofrecer tres opciones claras: «Citas para consultas y tratamientos», «Seguimiento de revisiones y recordatorios» y «Recuperación de pacientes que no han vuelto». • Preguntar únicamente el nombre, teléfono, fecha de nacimiento y servicio que necesita antes de intentar agendar. • Analizar el calendario y agendar la cita en la disponibilidad más próxima, en caso de superar la semana, enviar la solicitud de cita a un miembro del equipo que mantendrá el contacto con el cliente para que confirme el horario; una vez aprobada, devolver la confirmación al paciente junto con la ubicación y políticas básicas. • Registrar la cita en nuestro calendario (Google Calendar o similar) y programar recordatorios automáticos antes de la visita y en los controles posteriores. • Detectar pacientes que lleven tiempo inactivos, activar una campaña de re-enganche y ofrecer servicios relevantes según su historial. Registrar fecha de nacimiento para ofrecer al cliente una oferta especial por su cumpleaños. Busco una solución llave en mano: diseño del flujo conversacional, configuración del bot con la API oficial de WhatsApp o una plataforma como Twilio o Zenvia, integración con nuestro calendario y un pequeño panel donde pueda hacer ajustes básicos sin depender del desarrollador. Entrego acceso a mi número empresarial y al calendario; necesito documentación breve y una sesión de traspaso para el equipo."
requirements_list: Requisitos técnicos solicitados: PHP, Internet Marketing, Software Architecture, HTML, Automation, Chatbot, API Integration, AI Chatbot Development, Conversational AI, AI Workflow Automation.
Presupuesto asignado por el demandante: EUR 250 - 750.
Propuestas recibidas hasta ahora: 181 ofertas.
Cumplir con las especificaciones exactas de la petición textual y adjuntar muestra o portafolio.

opportunities.title: Easy Paid Phone Task, No Experience Needed (Lithuania Only)
opportunities.description: Easy paid task that anyone can do with a smartphone. No experience or special skills needed. Only for people living in Lithuania. What you'll do (one task, done from your phone): - Upload 2 real videos of yourself that were recorded at least 10 years ago (childhood videos are fine) - Record 8 short new clips of yourself (3 to 10 seconds each) in 8 different places, for example your room, kitchen, outside, a shop or a park - A simple 1-minute tutorial shows you exactly what to do The videos are used for AI training. Requirements: - You live in Lithuania and are 18 or older - Only you appear in your videos - Original files only: no videos from WhatsApp or social media, nothing compressed, edited or AI-generated, and the 2 old videos must really be 10+ years old (photos don't count) - One task per person Payment: paid per completed and approved task through a Freelancer milestone, after a quick quality review. Deadline: November 20, 2026. In your bid, please tell me your city, your age range, and whether you have 2 videos of yourself from 10+ years ago.

opportunities.title: Desarrollo de Plataforma Turística Bilingüe con Integración de Apis
opportunities.description: Se busca un desarrollador senior experto para crear una plataforma turística bilingüe (español/inglés) y de fácil administración para Tache Travel. La visión es permitir a los clientes encontrar promociones de navieras, entender tarifas, comparar opciones y reservar o solicitar asesoría personalizada, aprovechando la experiencia y conocimiento de Tache Travel. La plataforma debe integrar y mejorar el uso de sistemas existentes como Odysseus para cruceros y explorar soluciones autorizadas como Expedia o Bedsonline para hoteles, conservando las comisiones. Se requiere una auditoría inicial de la web, permisos de Outside Agents, APIs, proveedores, datos, pagos y comisiones para entregar una arquitectura viable, presupuesto y cronograma. Las funciones principales incluyen: 1. promociones sincronizadas: investigar y conectar con outside agents, odysseus, apis o fuentes oficiales de navieras como norwegian, royal caribbean, carnival, msc, celebrity, princess, holland america, virgin, entre otras. La plataforma deberá mostrar ofertas, vigencia, precios, condiciones y cruceros elegibles, con sincronización autorizada o gestión manual con control de vencimientos. 2. BUSCADOR Y COMPARADOR: Implementar un sistema para filtrar cruceros en promoción por naviera, destino, puerto, fecha, duración, tipo de cabina, precio y beneficios. Deberá detallar lo que incluye cada tarifa (bebidas, restaurantes, Wi-Fi, créditos, impuestos, propinas, cargos y restricciones) y conectar cada oferta con su proceso de reserva. 3. RESERVAS: Optimizar la integración de Odysseus para reservas de cruceros y evaluar la posibilidad de un buscador de hoteles con soluciones autorizadas, asegurando la conservación de comisiones. 4. WEB Y ADMINISTRACIÓN: Desarrollar un diseño premium y responsivo para dispositivos móviles. La plataforma incluirá secciones para cruceros, hoteles, resorts, paquetes, destinos y excursiones. Se necesita un panel de administración intuitivo para actualizar promociones y contenido bilingüe, además de integrar herramientas como HubSpot, WhatsApp, formularios de contacto, optimización SEO y analítica web. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

opportunities.title: ¿Sabes convertir una llamada en una venta? Buscamos experiencia rea...
opportunities.description: Queremos conocer a profesionales que sepan escuchar, generar confianza y cerrar una venta por teléfono. Nos interesa lo que puedes demostrar en una conversación, además de lo que figure en tu currículum. dos requisitos que no son negociables 1. Haber vendido por teléfono a clientes de España. Debes poder explicar qué vendías, a quién y cuál era tu responsabilidad en el cierre. Valoramos especialmente la venta a empresas y autónomos. 2. Voz clara, acento neutro, excelente dicción y español fluido. La comunicación se comprobará en una entrevista y una simulación. qué esperamos de ti que sepas abrir una llamada en frío con naturalidad, localizar a la persona que decide, hacer preguntas útiles y explicar una propuesta sin recitar un texto. Que puedas resolver objeciones, presentar el precio, pedir el cierre y organizar el seguimiento cuando el cliente necesite tiempo. Buscamos venta real: haber atendido llamadas o agendado citas, por sí solo, no cubre este puesto. También necesitamos manejo de CRM, registro de las gestiones y disponibilidad en horario comercial español. El trabajo es remoto: ordenador propio, auriculares con buen micrófono, conexión estable y un lugar silencioso. Cómo será la colaboración fijo más comisiones, formación inicial, herramientas y material de apoyo. Buscamos continuidad. Explicaremos el servicio durante el primer contacto y acordaremos condiciones y objetivos antes de comenzar. Cómo vamos a elegir realizaremos una entrevista y un ejercicio breve de llamada con situaciones comerciales ficticias, sin llamar a clientes reales. Evaluaremos voz, escucha, explicación, respuesta a objeciones y cierre. La experiencia indicada deberá poder explicarse con ejemplos concretos. al presentarte adjunta tu currículum y responde brevemente: • ¿qué vendiste por teléfono en españa y durante cuánto tiempo? • ¿a empresas, autónomos o particulares? ¿cerrabas tú la contratación? • ¿qué objetivo tenías y qué resultados obtenías? sin datos confidenciales. • ¿Qué CRM y programas de llamadas utilizabas? • ¿Qué horario de España puedes cubrir y cuándo podrías empezar? Si Workana lo permite, añade una presentación de voz de 30 a 60 segundos. El proceso se coordinará por esta plataforma. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Televentas Tiempo requerido: Más de 20 horas

opportunities.title: Reparar error 500 en OVH
opportunities.description: Llevo ya 24 horas con la web caída y cada visita devuelve un error 500/502. No aparece contenido, solo ese mensaje de servidor.
